name: Cao Bang food guide
summary: Cao Bang eats a sour pho in town, steamed rice rolls in bone broth, and a highland table of chestnut, mắc mật duck, and corn wine. Báo Cao Bằng, Vietnam Tourism, and the geopark name the plates. A price is Check on arrival.
body: Start in town, before the road. Phở chua is the sour bowl, not a hot beef pho. Bánh cuốn sits in pork-bone broth. Phở vịt is the hot duck bowl beside them. Autumn on the eastern road is Trùng Khánh chestnut. The geopark’s eastern route adds olive sticky rice, roast duck, and smoked sausage.
Give the meal its own hour in the city, or at the table on the road you already took for the falls. A price is Check on arrival.
specialtiesLead: The town bowls, then the chestnut, the duck, and the corn wine.

sections.heading: Cao Bang specialties
paragraphs: These are the plates and drinks Báo Cao Bằng, Vietnam Tourism, the geopark management board, and the Ministry of Culture, Sports and Tourism name. A price is Check on arrival. A stall hour is Check on arrival unless the line prints one.

Also named, with no method in the articles: tương đen Méc Cảng, cá trầm xanh, ong xào măng, thạch trắng, mác cà tắm, canh đỗ trắng nấu hoa chuối rừng, lê Đông Khê, kẹo ngà hoóc, bánh pẻng khua, bánh nướng, chè Tiên, a pear, yellow sugarcane, a red persimmon, and bỏng thóc théc on the 22 March 2023 route article, plus mèn mén, khẩu sli, and bánh ngô on that northern list. The ministry’s 22 August 2024 piece also names thịt chua Bảo Lạc, mận máu Bảo Lạc, thịt xông khói, thạch mác púp, several kinds of bún, bánh cuốn ngô, cá suối kho mắc mật, lẩu thắng cố, nộm thịt bò một nắng, vịt cỏ tiềm, and bánh chè lam, which it places on a national gift list with the black Phja Den noodles. Báo Cao Bằng on 3 May 2026 names tàu trúc, a mixed chè, bánh bò, bánh gai, and bánh rợm. The 1 September 2026 article names stuffed bamboo shoot, boiled bí hương, canh rau âu, peanut candy, and forest honey. A method for each of those is Check on arrival.

spots.name: Sour pho
spots.note: Vietnam Tourism calls this sour noodle soup and names it, with bánh cuốn, as a city specialty. Báo Cao Bằng on 21 May 2026 describes a different bowl from hot beef pho: rice noodles, roast duck, crisp pork belly, and smoked sausage, then a little duck broth, then a vinegar sauce thickened with canna starch and seasoned with sugar, salt, garlic, and chili. Fried sweet-potato threads, crushed roasted peanut, shredded cucumber, and herbs go on last. The 1 September 2026 article describes chewy noodles, duck, crisp fried potato, roasted peanut, herbs, and a sweet-sour dressing, and does not mention the duck broth. The 3 May 2026 article says roast meat, smoked sausage, roasted peanut, and a sweet-sour vinegar sauce, and that morning service in Thục Phán ward is limited. A stall hour and a price are Check on arrival.

spots.name: Steamed rice rolls
spots.note: Vietnam Tourism calls these steamed rice rolls. Báo Cao Bằng on 4 July 2012 says the sheet is local ordinary rice, soaked and wet-milled, filled with pork minced and fried with dried shallot, and eaten hot in a clear pork-bone broth with gio, cha, and egg. Chili pickled with mắc mật, fish sauce, and lime are optional. An egg cracked into the sheet while it steams is the egg roll in that same article. Stalls open from 4 to 5 in the morning. A closing time is Check on arrival. The 1 September 2026 article says the roll is not eaten with the familiar fish sauce: a white hot sheet, bone broth, minced pork, and scallion, with pickled bamboo chili. The Ministry of Culture, Sports and Tourism on 22 August 2024 says bánh cuốn Cao Bằng was chosen for a top 100 Vietnamese dish list. A price is Check on arrival.

spots.name: Duck pho
spots.note: Báo Cao Bằng on 1 September 2026 puts a hot duck pho at the start of a morning in town: soft noodles, fragrant firm duck, a rich broth, and the smell of spices and roast duck. The 3 May 2026 article calls the broth fragrant and rich, and sets it beside phở chua as the warmer bowl. The Ministry of Culture, Sports and Tourism on 22 August 2024 names phở vịt quay in a list and does not describe a second bowl. A stall hour and a price are Check on arrival.

spots.name: Five-colour sticky rice
spots.address: Cao Bang city and the highland roads
spots.note: Báo Cao Bằng on 22 March 2023 says five-colour sticky rice is Pì Pất or Ong glutinous rice, colored with plants, in five colors. The 1 September 2026 article names purple, green, and yellow from natural leaves, a soft grain with the smell of upland sticky rice, eaten with crushed roasted peanut, including as a small morning packet. It does not name five colors. The plants are Check on arrival. A price is Check on arrival.

spots.name: Fragrant sticky rice
spots.note: Báo Cao Bằng on 3 May 2026 names morning packets of xôi from gạo nếp hương: soft, fragrant, and nutty. That article does not call the packet five-colour rice. A dye, a stall hour, and a price are Check on arrival.

spots.name: Trung Khanh chestnut
spots.note: Báo Cao Bằng on 22 March 2023 describes Trùng Khánh chestnut as even and nearly round, with a dark glossy shell and a yellow kernel. Roasted, it is nutty, sweet, and aromatic. The same article says the nut is also boiled. The 1 September 2026 article calls it an autumn specialty, nutty, sweet, and aromatic, and a gift to carry home. A month and a price are Check on arrival.

spots.name: Chestnut green rice
spots.note: Báo Cao Bằng on 22 March 2023: young Pì Pất glutinous rice, still milky, boiled, dried, and pounded until the grain is translucent green, then rubbed with chestnut that has been boiled or roasted, peeled, and pounded. Eat it by the handful in autumn. A price is Check on arrival.

spots.name: Ham hock with chestnut
spots.note: Báo Cao Bằng on 22 March 2023 names ham hock stewed with chestnut as a food made from the Trùng Khánh nut. The 1 September 2026 article says the soft fatty hock meets the nutty sweet chestnut. A stall hour and a price are Check on arrival.

spots.name: Chestnut wine
spots.note: Báo Cao Bằng on 22 March 2023 names rượu hạt dẻ as a food made from the Trùng Khánh chestnut. A method, a strength, and a price are Check on arrival.

spots.name: Banh khao
spots.note: Báo Cao Bằng on 22 March 2023 groups bánh khảo with bánh pẻng phạ: fragrant and sweet, soft fine glutinous flour and honey. A separate method for pẻng phạ is Check on arrival. The 1 September 2026 article lists bánh khảo among gifts to carry home. A season and a price are Check on arrival.

spots.name: Roast duck
spots.note: The geopark management board, in its 18 July 2025 eastern-route article, names roast duck with olive sticky rice and smoked sausage. Báo Cao Bằng on 22 March 2023 names vịt quay tẩm lá mắc mật on that road. The 3 May 2026 article names vịt quay lá mắc mật as a morning dish and a gift. A roasting time and a price are Check on arrival.

spots.name: Dew-dried grass duck
spots.nameVi: Vịt cỏ phơi sương om mắc mật
spots.note: Báo Cao Bằng on 22 March 2023 names vịt cỏ phơi sương om mắc mật on the eastern route, apart from the roast duck. The name is the dish: a dew-dried grass duck stewed with mắc mật leaf. A time and a price are Check on arrival.

spots.name: Smoked sausage
spots.address: Eastern road, western road, and town
spots.note: The geopark’s 18 July 2025 eastern-route article names lạp sườn hun khói with roast duck and olive sticky rice. Báo Cao Bằng on 22 March 2023 names lạp sườn made from local black pork on the western route, with kitchen-hung pork and crisp belly. The 3 May 2026 article says travelers eat the smoked sausage or carry it home. A smoke time and a price are Check on arrival.

spots.name: Black-olive sticky rice
spots.note: The geopark’s 18 July 2025 eastern-route article names xôi trám. Báo Cao Bằng on 22 March 2023 names xôi vò trám đen on the western route, sticky rice worked with black olives. The 1 September 2026 article calls black-olive sticky rice an autumn specialty. The months and a price are Check on arrival.

spots.name: Olive with pork belly
spots.note: Báo Cao Bằng on 22 March 2023 names trám xào thịt ba chỉ on the western route: black olive stir-fried with pork belly. A season and a price are Check on arrival.

spots.name: Canna glass noodles
spots.note: Báo Cao Bằng on 22 March 2023 says western-route miến dong is clear and chewy, from canna, eaten as chicken soup, a mixed fry, or fried rolls, in that article’s autumn frame. The 1 September 2026 article says the strand is made from củ dong riềng, thin and chewy, and that a traditional soup uses the water from boiling chicken or pork bone. The Ministry of Culture, Sports and Tourism on 22 August 2024 names miến dong đen Phja Đén on a national gift list. A price is Check on arrival.

spots.name: Bamboo-tube rice
spots.note: Báo Cao Bằng on 22 March 2023 says cơm lam is glutinous rice put into a bamboo tube and roasted until done, on the northern route. Split the tube and peel the rice. A price is Check on arrival.

spots.name: Corn wine
spots.note: Báo Cao Bằng on 22 March 2023 calls corn wine the best-known drink of the northern kitchen. The yeast cake uses more than 20 forest leaves. Steamed corn is mixed with the yeast and rested about a month, then distilled. The paper calls a modest pour a restorative. A strength and a price are Check on arrival.

spots.name: Ash-soaked rice cake
spots.note: Báo Cao Bằng on 22 March 2023 says bánh gio is upland glutinous rice soaked in kitchen-ash water and wrapped in lá chít. A price is Check on arrival.

spots.name: Black chung cake
spots.note: Báo Cao Bằng on 22 March 2023 says bánh chưng đen is glutinous rice soaked with tro hoa muối. A filling, a boil time, and a price are Check on arrival.

spots.name: Ap chao
spots.note: Báo Cao Bằng on 1 September 2026 says bánh áp chao looks at first like a savory fried cake. The filling is duck. The shell is golden and crisp, the inside soft, and it is eaten with herbs, shredded green papaya, and a sweet-sour dip, in the afternoon. The 3 May 2026 article describes marinated meat in a soft batter, fried golden, crisp outside and soft and chewy inside, with herbs and a sweet-sour dip, and does not say the meat is duck. The September article says afternoon counters in the town center change their hours by the day. The ministry’s 22 August 2024 article says bánh áp chao was chosen for a top 100 Vietnamese dish list. A clock and a price are Check on arrival.

spots.name: Hot banh duc
spots.note: Báo Cao Bằng on 1 September 2026 describes a hot bánh đúc in the afternoon: soft, sticky, and dense, topped with minced pork stir-fried with wood ear, fried shallot, and herbs, with broth or a strong dip. It names the bowl for cool weather. A clock and a price are Check on arrival.

spots.name: Khau nhuc
spots.note: Báo Cao Bằng on 1 September 2026 says khau nhục is pork belly, steamed a long time, soft, with the fat balanced by seasoning. It names the dish on traditional feast tables. A spice list and a price are Check on arrival.

spots.name: Roast pig
spots.note: Báo Cao Bằng on 1 September 2026 describes lợn quay with crackling, then soft, sweet, fatty meat, seasoned with mắc mật leaf, eaten hot with herbs and a dipping sauce. The article places it at an evening meal. The ministry’s 22 August 2024 list also names lợn quay. A clock and a price are Check on arrival.

spots.name: Ant-egg cake
spots.note: Báo Cao Bằng on 3 May 2026 says bánh trứng kiến is a glutinous-rice sheet around a fatty ant-egg filling, with lá vả. The Ministry of Culture, Sports and Tourism on 22 August 2024 names the cake and does not describe it. A price is Check on arrival.

spots.name: Black jelly
spots.note: Báo Cao Bằng on 3 May 2026 says thạch đen is made from the thạch plant grown in Cao Bang. The taste is mild, the texture soft and smooth, and the bowl is a cool one in hot weather. The 22 March 2023 article names thạch đen on the eastern route and does not give this method. The 1 September 2026 article lists it as a gift. A price is Check on arrival.

spots.name: Thang Hen shrimp
spots.note: Báo Cao Bằng on 22 March 2023 names tép from Thang Hen lake, wrapped in green mustard leaf and lá lốt, on the eastern route. A season and a price are Check on arrival.

spots.name: Fresh-corn porridge
spots.note: Báo Cao Bằng on 22 March 2023 says cháo bẹ is porridge from fresh young corn flour, on the northern route. The ministry’s 22 August 2024 contest note names cháo bẹ rau măng and does not describe it. A price is Check on arrival.

spots.name: Soured pork with corn flour
spots.nameVi: Thịt lợn ủ chua với bột ngô
spots.note: Báo Cao Bằng on 22 March 2023 names thịt lợn ủ chua với bột ngô on the northern route: pork soured with corn flour. A time and a price are Check on arrival.

spots.name: Village chicken
spots.note: Báo Cao Bằng on 1 September 2026 says village chicken is firm, fragrant, and naturally sweet, and that it is boiled, steamed, grilled, or cooked with mountain vegetables. The same article describes an evening stew of that chicken with red pumpkin: sweet meat with soft, nutty squash. The ministry’s 22 August 2024 contest note names gà bản hầm hạt dẻ and does not describe it. A price is Check on arrival.

spots.name: Kitchen-hung meat
spots.note: Báo Cao Bằng on 22 March 2023 names thịt lợn treo from local black pork on the western route, and, on the northern route, beef and black pork hung over the kitchen fire. A smoke time and a price are Check on arrival.

spots.name: Crisp pork belly
spots.note: Báo Cao Bằng on 22 March 2023 names ba chỉ quay vàng rộm from local black pork on the western route. The 1 September 2026 roast pig, seasoned with mắc mật, is described separately. A price is Check on arrival.

spots.name: Banh giay
spots.note: Báo Cao Bằng on 22 March 2023 says bánh giày is made from Pì Pất or Ong glutinous rice, with sticky rice and the five-colour rice. A method beyond that rice, and a price, are Check on arrival.

sections.heading: Kim Dong
paragraphs: Kim Đồng is the walking street in Thục Phán ward. Báo Cao Bằng on 1 September 2026 places 19 produce stalls there for the National Day holiday. An ordinary-day clock is Check on arrival.

spots.name: Kim Dong walking street
spots.note: Báo Cao Bằng on 1 September 2026 places 19 produce stalls on the Kim Đồng walking street in Thục Phán ward for the National Day holiday, selling chestnut, bánh khảo, glass noodles, peanut candy, black jelly, and forest honey. An ordinary-day clock is Check on arrival. Stall prices are Check on arrival.

sections.heading: Breakfast
paragraphs: Morning in town is phở chua, bánh cuốn, phở vịt, five-colour sticky rice, and the fragrant sticky-rice packet. They are in the list above. Báo Cao Bằng on 4 July 2012 says bánh cuốn stalls open from 4 to 5 in the morning. A closing time is Check on arrival. Other stall hours are Check on arrival.

seoTitle: Cao Bang food guide — sour pho, chestnut, duck
seoDescription: Phở chua, bánh cuốn, Trùng Khánh chestnut, and mắc mật duck. Báo Cao Bằng and the geopark name the plates. A price is Check on arrival.
